newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Naphtha/Mogas-Taiwan gets brunt of high mogas.
newsitem.headline: Asia Naphtha/Mogas-Taiwan gets brunt of high mogas.

text.p: Both light distillates rose on Thursday with firmer overnight crude and bullish sentiment as Singapore weekly stocks fell and Taiwan made its highest award for reformate for some years.
Light distillate stocks, which comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha, fell 233,000 barrels to 5.187 million barrels, the lowest level in two months.
Traders said they thought the draw was mainly in gasoline as supplies were tight, reflected in Taiwan's award for its March 1-15 import tender for 95-octane unleaded reformate.
A company official from Taiwan's state-owned Chinese one 250,000 barrel cargo due receiving some of the highest offers its has ever received.
"It is the highest .. we have never paid so high," the official said. "We only awarded just one cargo because the number is not good."
CPC awarded the cargo at $27.60 per barrel c-and-f after negotiating down initial offers of $27.50-$28.00.
The official said CPC would emerge after the Chinese New Year in early February with a new tender for more March cargoes.
Traders expected more upside to gasoline prices as Wednesday's buyers re-emerged Thursday and bid at higher levels, but still there were no takers.
Cargoes of 95-octane were bid up to $26.20 per barrel, up 40 cents intraday and 50 cents from Wednesday.
Bids for 92-octane at $25.90 were similarly 50 cents higher than Wednesday's last bid, while 97-octane rose 75 cents to $28.00.

In comparison, there were still Singapore naphtha barrels available but little talk. The last trade done was on Tuesday, with a U.S. major saying he sold 240,000 barrels of light naphtha at $1.00 per barrel over Singapore quotes lifting late February to a Japanese end-user, higher than market assessed premiums of around 80 cents.
Paper naphtha rose, with February swaps firmer by 65 cents to close $24.10/$24.30 per barrel. (Prices are in dollars per barrel) MTH FOB SIN BUY/SELL PREV BUY/SELL
